name: Campingplatz Magdalena
beschreibung:
Campingplatz Magdalena is located in the Stubaital, about 15 kilometers south of Innsbruck. The site is situated on the edge of a small village, surrounded by meadows and with a view of the Stubai Alpen.

The facility offers pitches for motorhomes, tents and is open seasonally from May to October. Sanitary facilities, a small playground and a grocery store are part of the infrastructure. The campsite is suitable for nature lovers and hikers looking for a quiet place as a starting point for mountain tours.
